About

I am a beginner MERN stack developer with a passion for building modern web applications and learning new technologies.

I enjoy working with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB while improving my skills through real-world projects.

My goal is to write clean code, build useful applications, and continue growing as a full-stack developer.
